data.long_meaning: In Greek, Vick means 'strength' or 'power'. This name is derived from the Greek word 'vikos', which can be translated as 'powerful' or 'strong'. In the New Testament, there is a saint named Victor, who was a martyr and is revered as the patron saint of actors and those with epilepsy. The name Vick carries the meaning “Power, Strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Vick usually hope their child will grow to embody power, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of inner strength and courage.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vick total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Its root in Greek history signifies the power of God in one's life, reminding us that we are all endowed with divine strength and capability. Ultimately, the name Vick is a call to embrace the power of God within ourselves and to use that power to live a meaningful and purposeful life.
